items.t: Wrote in an op-ed that a yes vote on LR 131 would protect infants born alive and said it affects only medical providers who intentionally allow them to die.
items.q: A YES vote for LR 131 will do exactly what the title states — protect all infants that are born alive. This is different from the abortion debate. This law only affects medical providers intentionally allowing children born alive to perish.
